issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 05 asks students to output the 'Namen aller Gemeinde' (names of all municipalities) in Oberbayern or Niederbayern that have a hiking trail (problem-statement.md line 37). The base reference solution uses 'SELECT Gemeinde.name' without an alias, producing a result column named 'name'. However, the variant solution (solution/aufgabe05.sql line 1) introduces an unnecessary alias: 'SELECT Gemeinde.name as G_Name', which changes the output column identifier to 'G_Name'. The problem statement never mentions 'G_Name' as a column label, and students who correctly write 'SELECT Gemeinde.name' following the specification will produce output with column name 'name', which will not match the reference solution column 'G_Name', causing the automatic equality check (test_a05_checkEquality) to fail for a correctly implemented query.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the alias 'as G_Name' from solution/aufgabe05.sql line 1, restoring the original 'SELECT Gemeinde.name' so the output column name matches the natural identifier expected by the problem statement and the equality test.
